resolution.note: host entry scripts/claude/context-gauge.ts restored; wiresOwnGauge recognizes the dispatcher; regression test

title: The host context-gauge hook entry exists again
body:
Source: operator 2026-11-16: recurring "UserPromptSubmit hook error" and "PostToolUse:ToolSearch hook error". ~/.claude/settings.json runs .krn/product-release/scripts/claude/context-gauge.ts --host; #1148 (12ec94e, t-1v46dxv) deleted that script, so the host hook exits 1 on every prompt and tool call in every project.
Outcome: scripts/claude/context-gauge.ts exists as the host entry (exit 0 on a UserPromptSubmit payload), and wiresOwnGauge recognizes a project that wires the dispatcher (src/dispatch/main.ts), so KRN is not gauged twice.
Proof: `node --test test/claude/context-gauge.test.ts` passes, including a test that the host entry script exists and exits 0 on a UserPromptSubmit payload.
Files: scripts/claude/context-gauge.ts, src/context/gauge.ts, test/claude/context-gauge.test.ts
